reason: Sensemaking is defined as an ongoing process with seven properties, not as a quantity read from observations of a unit at a horizon. The book states no directional relation between measured constructs. No kernel-conformant construct or proposition can be written without inventing a measurement model the text does not supply.
ambiguities: A measurement-model reading (for example, frequency of sensemaking episodes) would be an addition by the formalizer, not a formalization of the source.
